text: Lumen Library digital books expire after 21 days. Digital loans cannot be renewed. Members can borrow at most 5 digital books at a time. Offline access requires downloading before the loan expires.
Lumen Library reservations are held for 3 days after notification. Members can reserve at most 4 books at once. Uncollected reservations are released to the next member after the holding period.

Lumen Library opens at 09:00 from Monday to Friday and closes at 18:00. Saturday opening is 10:00 to 14:00. The library is closed on Sunday. These are fictional benchmark rules, not real opening hours.

Lumen Library is a fictional benchmark organisation. Standard book loans last 14 days. A member may renew a book once, provided no other member has reserved it. Reference books must remain inside the library.

Lumen Library membership is free. A member must present an identification document at registration. The fictional benchmark stores no identity documents or personal information. Guest access allows reading on site only.

Lumen Library accepts book returns at the main desk during opening hours. There is no outdoor return box. A damaged book must be reported to a librarian. The replacement fee for damaged books is not specified in this handbook.
Lumen Library study rooms can be booked for 2 hours. A group can have at most 6 people. A booking is cancelled if nobody arrives within 15 minutes. Food is prohibited in study rooms.

Lumen Library support replies within 2 working days. Questions about lost property are handled by the main desk. The handbook does not specify a phone number or an email address. Never invent contact details.
